description.en: Starts moving a character handle toward a target position/value set (typically [x, y, z, speed]), to be polled with CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_IS_MOVING.
Target position/value array, e.g. [x, y, z, speed].
The character's move-manager entry as an integer (0 if the handle doesn't resolve to a registered character); null only if the call itself was invalid (missing required arguments).
